info.name: CDR Banking Banking Account Balances Products API

params.name: effective
params.description: Allows for the filtering of products based on whether the current time is within the period of time defined as effective by the effectiveFrom and effectiveTo fields.

params.name: updated-since
params.description: Only include products that have been updated after the specified date and time. If absent defaults to include all products

params.name: brand
params.description: Filter results based on a specific brand

params.name: product-category
params.description: Used to filter results on the productCategory field applicable to accounts. Any one of the valid values for this field can be supplied. If absent then all accounts returned.

params.name: page
params.description: Page of results to request (standard pagination)

params.name: page-size
params.description: Page size to request. Default is 25 (standard pagination)

items.docs: Obtain a list of products from the company that are currently openly offered to the market

params.name: productId
params.description: ID of the specific product requested (found using GET /banking/products)

items.docs: Obtain detailed information on a single product offered openly to the market.
